summary: Both completion conditions verified on merged main (PR #354, merge commit dd97387): doctor.provider.repo_json reports pass, and doctor.github.branch_protection is evaluated rather than skipped behind doctor.github.online. The branch-protection finding is fail, which is the intended outcome: it surfaces the pre-existing mismatch between .shiki/config.yaml and live protection (missing required check 'MergeGate metadata check'; required review count 0 < 1).
